niche.habitat: Shallow tidal flats, sulfide seeps, rift margins.
niche.active: Diurnal; crepuscular peaks when tides expose vents.

body: Bilateral, hex-plate armor of iron-sulfide, internal magnetite chains, magnetite-tipped mandibles, siphon for low-frequency humming.

chains.trait: Internal magnetite chains lock to magnetic north.

skill.effect: Immune to disorientation from wind/tides; +20% navigation speed.

observe: Aligns body parallel to magnetic meridian
Rests with shell plates clamped tight

journal.en: Their bones are compass needles; they walk by the pull of the world.

chains.trait: Scales of iron-sulfide resist acid and impact.
links: Immune to acid fog and predators
Acidic rift chemistry and sulfide crusts

skill.effect: -60% damage from acid/bleach attacks; +30% damage resistance.

chains.weakness: Heavy armor limits movement speed to slow.
observe: Rust-colored plates etched by acid mist
No predators dare bite the shell
Siphon vents when fog rolls in

journal.en: Armor forged in poison; nothing cracks the siderogon's back.

skill.effect: Breaks hard armor; deals 15 damage and breaks guard.

chains.weakness: Teeth shatter if struck against solid rock.
observe: Feeds only on crusty mineral mats
Teeth grow back slowly after damage

journal.en: Teeth like magnets, eating the earth's iron bones.

skill.effect: Summons herd from 120m; calms allies, +10% defense sync.

chains.weakness: Attracts predators who hunt by sound.
observe: Herds gather within seconds of call

journal.en: A voice like grinding tectonic plates calls them home.

relations.note: (council kind 'predator') Siderogon grazes mats but spores regrow crusts within days.
(council kind 'predator') Sidero-chisp hunts juvenile or sick siderogons in lagoon margins.
(council kind 'mutualist') Siderogons may graze non-toxic roots or use sidero-copa for shelter.

secrets: Radar target: magnetite makes them glow on magnetic sensors.
Herd leader has unique hum frequency; copying it summons followers.
Lightning can charge a siderogon, increasing electrical output temporarily.
moments: When the wind dies, the herds lock their shells with a thunder-clap of magnetism, standing like rusted statues against the acid mist, humming a chord that vibrates in your chest.
